Messages.Author: Wes
Messages.Body:
"hamdamcwa" <dave...@hotmail.com> wrote
>
> Deck Name: Shock Tactics

I like 'Shock Opera' better but it's your deck...

> Created by: Lasombra Shock Troops Deck
> Description:
>
> Crypt: (12 cards) [Min: 13, Max: 37, Avg: 6.17]
> 1 Aaron Duggan (obt, Lasombra, 2)
> 1 Ambrosio Luis Monçada (aus DOM for OBT POT PRE, Lasombra, 10,
Cardinal)
> 1 Angelica (cel DOM obf OBT POT, Lasombra, 10,
Cardinal)
> 1 Antonio Delgado (DOM OBT POT tha, Lasombra, 9,
Archbishop)
> 1 Aurora Van Brande (dom for OBT pot, Lasombra, 6)
> 1 Cameron (dom pot, Lasombra, 3)
> 1 Gratiano (DOM obf OBT pot, Lasombra, 8, Priscus)
> 1 Ignacio (dom obt pot, Lasombra, 4)
> 2 Lisette Vizquel (DOM POT pro, Lasombra, 6, Bishop)
> 1 Ramiro (dom obt vic, Lasombra, 4)
> 1 Talley (aus dom OBT POT, Lasombra, 6)

I'd stick to duplicates of one or two Archbishops/Cardinals with DOM and
ditch the rest. Better to start off with what you need for the Shock Troops,
rather than wait for the right guys. Moncada might be nice since he can play
deflections and prevent the need for lots of WWEF cards. Lazvernius isn't a
Lasombra of course but he might be ok here with both DOM and POT.

The AB/C will be enough for the Shock Troops, plus you can use the DOM to
deflect any bleeds forward. Timing and hand-jam seem like they might be a
severe crimp in this deck's performance.

> Library: (89 cards)
> Master (30 cards)
> 1 Barrens, The
> 3 Blood Doll
> 2 Heidelburg Castle, Germany

Hmm... to prevent the need for the Shocked Troopers to hunt as they are
created? I'm not sure this is legal. The ST card says they *must* hunt the
turn they are created, regardless of the amount of blood on them (LSJ?). I'm
not sure if that is why you included this but it might be a consideration so
I'll mention it anyway.

> 1 Minion Tap
> 1 Parthenon, The
> 1 Political Hunting Ground

I doubt you'll get blocked while hunting with weenie POT guys... may be
unnecessary.

> 11 Potence
> 2 Power Structure

Makes for a pretty solid vote defense once the lil' ones start coming out,
plus you obviously already have at least 2 votes on the table. It's not
however *required*. You'll have a few votes from minions already--why not
just rush any voters that irk you?

> 6 Shock Troops

I'd give this deck as many STs as you include Potence cards. Maybe 8 of
each?

> 1 Storage Annex

I have a feeling this card will be *very* important to you. Maybe more...

> 1 Sudden Reversal

Haven Uncovereds work with the weenie potence... maybe a few of those?
Masters are tight in this deck though...

> Minion (59 cards)
> 3 Ambush
> 1 Ancient Influence
> 1 Blood Feast
> 4 Bum's Rush

With little rushers and an AB/C, I think War Party is preferrable to
transient rush cards.

> 1 Cardinal Benediction
> 1 Crusade: Miami
> 1 Crusade: Philadelphia

You should remove most of the votes and just concentrate on the rushes.
Forward offense should be deflections and maybe some big DOM bleeds with the
AB/C. Maybe a Rumors of Gehenna to give you more Masters? You could always
share it with another vote deck.

> 3 Deflection

Many, many more... with enough WWEFs to send them on their merry way.

> 7 Disarm

Combine this with Leather Jacket... Nice, simple, deadly.

> 2 Disputed Territory

I don't think you need this.

> 2 Eyes of the Night

To block what? You'll have lots of votes, you'll be able to rush any one who
bothers you and bleeds can be deflected.

> 2 Govern the Unaligned

Maybe a few more for some forward motion?

> 3 Graverobbing
> 3 Immortal Grapple

With lots of 'lil ones' I don't think you even need IGs. They can waste
their Majesty cards, but you'll just be rushing them with three other guys.

> 9 Leather Jacket
> 2 Pier 13, Port of Baltimore

Doesn't work. The LJs will be going to the Troopers most of the time and
they can't afford to spend blood on this.

> 4 Shadow Play
> 3 Thrown Gate

More!

> 3 Undead Strength

More!

> 3 Wake with Evening's Freshness

More!

> 1 War Party

Actually, this card might be a nice substitute for Haven Uncovered
considering you will have an Archbishop/Cardinal already. Maybe more of
these?

Try this out! Seems interesting. I'd like to see a deck do something with
Shock Troops. I have one or two to contribute to the cause if needed :)

Messages.Author: Tim Olivas
Messages.Body:
The Shock Troop Deck that ALMOST Works

I racked my brain trying to come up with a Shock Troops deck that would
work, and finally came up with this freaky Brujah/!Brujah Rush/Revolt
deck. It's fragile as hell, but it ALMOST works. I'm hoping for advice
on how to make it go.

Crypt (12 cards, 6 vampires, 12 best, 20 worst, 4.2 average)
4 x Jacko (!Bru, 8, CEL POT)
2 x Victor Tolliver (!Bru, 4, CEL pot)
2 x Volker, the Puppet Prince (Bru, 5, CEL pot)
2 x Black Cat (Bru, 5, CEL pot)
2 x Rigby, Crusader Vanguard (!Bru, 5, CEL pot)

Library (60 Cards total)

Masters (18)
Anarch Revolt x 4
Antediluvian Awakening
Barrens, the
Blood Doll
Celerity x 6
Fragment of the Book of Nod
Regent
Shock Troops
Tribute to the Master
Waste Management Operation

Minion (42)

Actions:
Ambush x 3
Bum's Rush x 3

Combat:
Acrobatics x 2
Blur x 3
Flash x 2
Psyche x 3
Pursuit x 1
Quickness x 2
Taste of Vitae x 7
Thrown Sewer Lid x 10
Zip Gun x 6

The idea, in case it isn't clear, is to bring out Jacko and another
rusher and pound the snot out of your predator and prey's vampires with
manuvers and up to 5 TSLs and Zip strikes a round (Jacko + Blur +
Quickness). Use the Barrens and the Fragment to discard your Celerity
and Shock Troop masters as quickly as you can, then use Waste Management
Operation to slap them on the bottom of your deck, followed by a
Tribute to the Master. Play or discard AR/AA as convenient. The deck
MUST cycle 10+ cards a round if you're going to get to the payoff in
time: Bring out 6 Shock Troops with Regent Jacko, hunt, next turn play
Tribute, hunt, put Tribute on the bottom, next turn play Tribute, hunt .
. . you need to keep the AA and AR in play to oust your opponents, so if
they're burnt or discarded get them back with WMO.

Again, it ALMOST works. The Rush is often good enough to knock out your
prey's blood gain so that the AA & AR polish him off, and you can slap
down many a predator too. But I've never gotten to the punchline! I
think the deck needs earlier pool gain. Suggestions?

--
Tim Olivas ("I'm so vital!"). . "I ain't no hell of a man...but listen,
tol...@core.com. . . . . . . . I'm going on a hell of a trip."
http://members.core.com/~tolivas/ . . . . . . . . . . --Ernest Hemingway

Oooooh! Now there's an idea - Waste management. I like this a lot.
Problem for you though - one Sudden Reversal.

Also, I wouldn't call this a "Shock Troops" deck, since you are only
intending to get about 6 Troops out, and you have 1 (unlikely)
combination open to you to play them (make Jacko Regent).

Nevertheless, I do like the idea of WMO and Shock Troops...

> Minion (42)
>
> Actions:
> Ambush x 3
> Bum's Rush x 3
>
> Combat:
> Acrobatics x 2
> Blur x 3
> Flash x 2
> Psyche x 3
> Pursuit x 1
> Quickness x 2
> Taste of Vitae x 7
> Thrown Sewer Lid x 10
> Zip Gun x 6

This will last you for 6 combats, all things being equal, but leaves
you screwed if YOU get rushed! Not to mention the fact that you have
nothing to stop S:CE effectively - Psyche only restarts combat, so you
loose your best cards and pay another blood for the zip gun.

Of course, it's all down to the metagame. In teh UK, this would last
10 seconds. Elsewhere, it would clean tables.

> The idea, in case it isn't clear, is to bring out Jacko and another
> rusher and pound the snot out of your predator and prey's vampires with
> manuvers and up to 5 TSLs and Zip strikes a round (Jacko + Blur +

> Tribute, hunt, put Tribute on the bottom, next turn play Tribute, hunt .
> . . you need to keep the AA and AR in play to oust your opponents, so if
> they're burnt or discarded get them back with WMO.

I doubt this would work - no IGs = no kills. Very few presses too...
it would just take 6 Skin of Steels and your entire strategy gets
railroaded.

> Again, it ALMOST works. The Rush is often good enough to knock out your
> prey's blood gain so that the AA & AR polish him off, and you can slap
> down many a predator too. But I've never gotten to the punchline! I
> think the deck needs earlier pool gain. Suggestions?

Some forward motion (presence bleed).

More votes, esp Crusade votes.

For a Shock Trooper deck, more Shock Troops, WMO, !Brujah (You need
the Archbishops / Cardinals, therefore get rid off the Cammies).

For a rush deck with a twist, it'll suffice but without IGs, it could
really end up in trouble.
